title: For each instance display name, show the instance memory variance and stand
question: For each instance display name, show the instance memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MEMORY_MB) for instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'blaze8-12', along with the instance UUID, availability zone, number of completed migrations, and total memory processed for matching instances running on host 'prime-35'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_instances AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.availability_zone, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM instance_system_metadata ism
      WHERE ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
        AND ism.deleted = 0
        AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    )
),
memory_stats AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS memory_variance,
         STDDEV(memory_mb) AS memory_stddev
  FROM eligible_instances
  GROUP BY display_name
),
completed_migration_counts AS (
  SELECT i.display_name,
         COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM instance_system_metadata ism
      WHERE ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
        AND ism.deleted = 0
        AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    )
  GROUP BY i.display_name
),
prime35_memory AS (
  SELECT i.display_name,
         SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'prime-35'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
)
SELECT ei.display_name,
       ms.memory_variance,
       ms.memory_stddev,
       ei.uuid,
       ei.availability_zone,
       COALESCE(mc.completed_migrations, 0) AS completed_migrations,
       COALESCE(pm.total_memory_processed, 0) AS total_memory_processed
FROM eligible_instances ei
JOIN memory_stats ms ON ei.display_name = ms.display_name
LEFT JOIN completed_migration_counts mc ON ei.display_name = mc.display_name
LEFT JOIN prime35_memory pm ON ei.display_name = pm.display_name
ORDER BY ei.display_name, ei.uuid
